title: 第9章 若是不凡就走自己的路第10章 我不是来夺旗的是来宰人的
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: 玄天宗少主秦云之名，很早之前就已经传遍洛城区域了，因为每一次外出，至少都会有一到两名长老随同。
让人不理解的是，秦云本身天赋一般，偏偏玄天宗上下都对秦云很紧张和关心。
曾经有一次秦云意外失踪了。
结果玄天宗所有人都出动了，搜遍了整个洛城。
从那个时候开始，秦云在洛城就有了一个所有人都耳熟能详的外号——宗保男。
“你要说他是个天才也就算了，一个废物般的家伙，凭什么得到玄天宗的全员拥护？”
有人不太理解。
“或许是他身世不凡。”
“你是说书的听多了吧，哪来这么多身世不凡的人。”
坐在御兽宗高位上的林淮月，看着下面被簇拥而过的秦云，眼中闪过浓浓的不屑。
废物终究是废物，除了被玄天宗的长老们和弟子保护，当宗保男外，还能做什么？
就算以后成为玄天宗的宗主，也守不住玄天宗，最后还不是落个凄惨的下场。
她就不一样了。
现在已经是洛城地榜第十位了，而且还是准宗子，未来有很大的希望成为御兽宗的宗主候选人。
未来前途光明。
“慕容师兄，你答应过我的，说帮我杀光玄天宗的弟子……”
林淮月拉着慕容博的手臂撒娇道。
“林师妹放心，玄天宗就只有一个洛城地榜的弟子而已，而且还是排名第六十位的家伙。
对付这样的家伙，我只需要一刀就够了，剩余的垃圾，随手就能斩杀。”
慕容博笑道。
宗主已经找过他了，有意让林淮月和他成亲。
对此，慕容博并无意见。
毕竟林淮月无论是潜力还是实力，都不差。
虽说林淮月以前是秦云的未婚妻，可能不是初次了，但是他不在乎，反正女人他多的是，但是像潜力这么强的女人只有林淮月一个而已。
林淮月见慕容博答应下来，笑容更加灿烂了，只是看到被一众长老簇拥的秦云的时候，她还是有些不爽。
因为没办法宰了秦云为自己父亲报仇。
不过没关系。
十宗大会开启之时，杀光玄天宗弟子。
就当讨回一些利息。
以后再慢慢对付秦云。
坐在第一高位上的蟒袍年轻男子瞥了秦云一眼，嘴角微微扯动了一下，对一旁的许城主问道：“这是哪个宗门的家伙，这么嚣张？”
“他是玄天宗少主秦云。”
许城主连忙回道。
“一个小小的宗门少主，排场就这么大？”
蟒袍年轻男子颇有些不悦，要不是各个宗门的女弟子比较养眼，没空理会的话，早就收拾这个家伙了。
content_en:
The name of Qin Yun, the young master of the Xuantian Sect, has spread throughout the Luocheng area a long time ago, because every time he goes out, there will be at least one or two elders accompanying him.
What people don't understand is that Qin Yun himself has average talent, but everyone in the Xuantian Sect is very nervous and concerned about Qin Yun.
Qin Yun once disappeared unexpectedly.
As a result, everyone in the Xuantian Sect mobilized and searched the entire Luo City.
From that time on, Qin Yun had a nickname that was familiar to everyone in Luo City - Zong Baonan.
"It doesn't matter if you say he is a genius. How can a useless guy get the support of everyone in the Xuantian Sect?"
Some people don't quite understand.
"Perhaps he has an extraordinary background."
"You must have listened to a lot of storytellers. How can there be so many people with extraordinary backgrounds?"
Lin Huaiyue, who was sitting in the high position of the Beast Control Sect, looked at Qin Yun who was surrounded by people below, with deep disdain flashing in her eyes.
Waste is waste after all. Apart from being protected by the elders and disciples of Xuantian Sect and being the sect’s protector, what else can they do?
Even if he becomes the leader of Xuantian Sect in the future, he will not be able to defend Xuantian Sect, and he will end up miserable in the end.
She is different.
He is now ranked tenth on the Luocheng Earth Ranking, and he is also a quasi-sect son. He has great hope of becoming a candidate for the master of the Beast Control Sect in the future.
The future looks bright.
"Senior Brother Murong, you promised me that you would help me kill all the Xuantian Sect disciples..."
Lin Huaiyue took Murong Bo's arm and said coquettishly.
"Junior sister Lin, don't worry, Xuantian Sect only has one disciple who is ranked in Luocheng's ranking list, and he is ranked sixtieth.
To deal with such a guy, I only need one knife, and the rest of the trash can be killed easily. "
Murong Bo smiled.
The sect leader has already approached him and intends to let Lin Huaiyue marry him.
Murong Bo had no objection to this.
After all, Lin Huaiyue is not bad in terms of potential and strength.
Although Lin Huaiyue was Qin Yun's fiancée before, it might not be her first time, but he didn't care. He had many women anyway, but there was only one woman with such great potential, Lin Huaiyue.
Seeing Murong Bo agree, Lin Huaiyue's smile became even brighter, but she was still a little unhappy when she saw Qin Yun surrounded by a group of elders.
Because there was no way to kill Qin Yun to avenge his father.
But it doesn't matter.
When the Ten Sects Conference opened, all the Xuantian Sect disciples were killed.
Just get some interest back.
I will deal with Qin Yun slowly in the future.
The young man in python robe sitting in the highest position glanced at Qin Yun, twitched the corner of his mouth slightly, and asked City Master Xu on the side: "Which sect is this guy, so arrogant?"
"He is Qin Yun, the young master of Xuantian Sect."
City Lord Xu quickly replied.
"A small young master of a sect can be so grand?"
The young man in the python robe was quite displeased. If the female disciples from various sects were not eye-catching and had no time to pay attention, they would have dealt with this guy long ago.
title_en: Chapter 9 If you are extraordinary, go your own way Chapter 10 I’m not here to capture the flag, I’m here to kill people
